description: A white AirPods-style charging case with a short white charging cable is on a green tabletop in front of you. The right hand steadies the case as a right-hand object, while the left hand reaches in from the left, grips the cable near the plug as a left-hand object, and pulls it outward to unplug it from the case, then lets the cable end rest on the table while the right hand keeps holding the case.
